records.sentence: The Duke of Edinburgh Award gave them the freedom and inspiration to do something.
records.haiku_rationale: The sentence refers to freedom as empowerment—the award enabled participants to have the capacity and opportunity to take action ("to do something"), rather than freedom from interference with an existing activity.
